mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above 4% for two consecutive months predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days due to tightened discount rates affecting future equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% and remains >4% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window following the trigger, SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from the prior 60-day average (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS reverts below 4% within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly UNRATE falls below 5% for three consecutive months, it indicates weakening labor market conditions that coincide with a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as investors anticipate slower corporate hiring.
failure_condition: In at least 60% of post-trigger windows of 20 days, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive, or UNRATE recovers to ≥5% within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly rise in HOUST (household spending index) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in INDPRO (industrial production) signals demand-pull inflation concerns, leading to a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days as market anticipates rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >3% in a month while INDPRO decreases by >2% in the same month
failure_condition: Over 50% of 5-day windows meeting the trigger, SPX 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05), or the correlation between HOUST and INDPRO is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO of at least 2% followed by a rise in GDPC1 (personal consumption) exceeding 1% suggests improving supply conditions that support a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases for 2 consecutive months then GDPC1 increases by >1% in the third month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns remain negative in 70% of post-trigger periods, or the correlation between INDPRO decline and GDPC1 rise is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for four consecutive months, it signals accommodative policy sustaining equity risk appetite, resulting in a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 60-day average prior to the trigger (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS reverts above 2% within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden one-time monthly spike in PAYEMS (employment) exceeding 100,000 jobs followed by two months of flat employment predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as market anticipates over-heating labor markets and potential policy tightening.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 100,000 for a single month then remains ≤100,000 for two following months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 80% of such events, or PAYEMS reverts to >100,000 within 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in both HOUST and GDPC1 exceeding 2% suggest robust consumer and business demand, which typically precede a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days as market anticipates continued economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >2% and GDPC1 increases by >2% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not positive in >70% of triggered windows, or the joint movement of HOUST and GDPC1 is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A three-month declining trend in RSAFS (raw material prices) combined with a stable UNRATE suggests easing supply constraints, which should produce a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as inflation risks diminish.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases for 3 consecutive months while UNRATE remains within [3.5%, 6.5%]
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) in 75% of such supply easing episodes, or RSAFS resumes rising before the 20-day window closes.
